rationale: The short thesis remains intact as the broad market has weakened further (SPY down -2.65% vs -2.06% at entry) and IESC continues to trade below both its falling 5-minute 9-EMA ($157.48) and session VWAP ($165.19). Recent 1-minute bounce attempts are occurring on low, contracting volume (~500–600 shares per minute) and failing to reclaim the 9-EMA, supporting continuation toward the $154.50 target near session lows.
